review.style: Matched against the existing sage ledger book: rounded matte paper layers, warm ivory and muted sage/peach/blue/yellow palette, no gloss, lettering, face or sparkle.
review.inspection: Each original was visually inspected; each encoded runtime image was additionally resized to 32x32 for individual visual review. No image content was redrawn, cropped, composited or edited after generation.
review.runtimeAlpha: All twelve 160px WebP files have RGBA channels, alpha extrema [0,255] and all four corners alpha=0.

encoding.operations: Square resize and encoding only; original PNG files copied byte-for-byte.
